speaker: customer
stance: I came back because the unclear offer on my first visit left me unsure what I would get.
topic: signing up from the landing page

functional.happened: The sign-up button scrolled me to the pricing table instead of opening the form.
functional.expected: The form to open right where I clicked.

experience: I felt a little lost for a moment, then relieved once I found the form.

expectations.assumed: Signing up would ask for a card.
expectations.actually: It only asked for an email, which made me more willing to try.

whatIDidInstead: I scrolled back up and found the form myself.
wantedInstead: One click from the headline straight to the form.
